name: @meekojs/meeko
description: Typed .meeko component engine with SSR, hydration, signals, Vite, and DevTools.

scripts.test: node scripts/clean-test-tmp.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
scripts.example:compile: node dist/cli.js compile examples/counter/Counter.meeko examples/counter/Counter.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/attributes/Attributes.meeko examples/attributes/Attributes.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/regions/Regions.meeko examples/regions/Regions.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile examples/primitives/Primitives.meeko examples/primitives/Primitives.generated.ts
scripts.example:bundle: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:compile && esbuild examples/counter/client.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=examples/counter/client.bundle.js
scripts.vite:types: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js types examples/counter/Counter.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/regions/Regions.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/vite/Hot.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/nested/Parent.meeko && tsc -p examples/vite/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.pilot:check: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js check examples/pilot/App.meeko && node dist/cli.js types examples/pilot/App.meeko && tsc -p examples/pilot/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.e2e: pnpm run example:bundle && pnpm run vite:build && tsx --test tests/browser.e2e.ts tests/editor-bridge.e2e.ts tests/teleport.e2e.ts tests/popover-select.e2e.ts
scripts.benchmark:check: pnpm run example:compile && node dist/cli.js compile benchmarks/cases/TreeLeaf.meeko benchmarks/cases/TreeLeaf.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile benchmarks/cases/TreeBranch.meeko benchmarks/cases/TreeBranch.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile benchmarks/cases/Tree.meeko benchmarks/cases/Tree.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile benchmarks/cases/List.meeko benchmarks/cases/List.generated.ts && node dist/cli.js compile benchmarks/cases/Navigation.meeko benchmarks/cases/Navigation.generated.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.benchmark.json --noEmit
scripts.benchmark: pnpm run build && pnpm run benchmark:check && node --expose-gc --import tsx benchmarks/run.ts
scripts.benchmark:scenarios: pnpm run build && pnpm run benchmark:check && node --expose-gc --import tsx benchmarks/scenarios.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run example:check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && pnpm run vite:types && pnpm run benchmark:check && pnpm run vite:build && pnpm run pilot:check
